{{Top|leg}}
'''Sense lattices''' were ancient forms of [[Baragwin/Legends|Baragwin]] recording technology that could store both visual and audio data. One containing the testimony of an [[Unidentified Republic soldier (Falang Minor)|anonymous soldier]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], who had been stationed [[Falang Minor]] after the end of the [[Tionese War]], was stored in the [[Palace of Memnii]] on [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]]. A copy of the sense lattice's record survived the [[Caamas Firestorm]] of [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] as it was in a traveling exhibit at the time.
